Update 24.09: Added a new, free tram

--- Thank you for three years of Tram Simulator Abenstedt! ---

Tram Simulator Abenstedt is a fictional German game in its early development stages.
Currently, 40 stations and 4 tram lines are included.
The game consists of detailed lines through a diverse cityscape - modern and classic residential districts, malls, rivers, parks and much more - and features a variety of detailed real and fictional tram models from all across Germany.

Have fun playing the game!
